title: Q3 Pricing Rollout Plan
text:
Owner: Alice Chen

Goal: migrate all Enterprise accounts to the new $89/seat plan during Q3 without exceeding a 0.5% involuntary churn budget.

Timeline:
- July 28: flags on, pricing page updated
- Aug 4: grandfathered accounts notified
- Sept 1: legacy plan sunset

Risks: the annual-prepay cohort renews in August; billing must prorate correctly or support volume will spike.
